summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation, as registrant, solely to disclose a periodic distribution to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-2 certificates. The filing includes a trustee's report detailing interest received and per-certificate income for the April 15, 2026 distribution date. There are no terms or events indicating an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special situation. The registrant explicitly disclaims involvement in the preparation of issuer reports. This is a standard asset-backed securities distribution notice with no transactional or corporate action element.
